description: This Java class 'ModifyAclSubstitutionStrategy' handles substitution for Access Control List (ACL) AuthorizationSubjects within a 'ModifyAcl' command. It extends an abstract substitution strategy, performs null checks, and potentially returns a modified copy of the command with substituted ACLs.

classes.name: ModifyAclSubstitutionStrategy
classes.description: A final class that extends AbstractTypedSubstitutionStrategy to handle substitution logic for ModifyAcl commands, focusing on ACL AuthorizationSubjects.

methods.name: ModifyAclSubstitutionStrategy
methods.description: Constructor that specifies the target class for this substitution strategy.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Performs the substitution on a given ModifyAcl object, replacing the ACL with a substituted version if necessary, or returning the original if no changes are needed.
